Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the fix and the affected area (shapes), but it is vague about the main change. The changeset mainly makes SPARQL argument cardinality errors stay catchable only under the November draft profile, updates the concat tests, and bumps OpenAPI version fields in a golden file. The title covers part of that work, so it passes as partially related. It does not name the main behavior change, though.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description explains the change. It says earlier SHACL profiles must reject multi-valued scalar arguments before SPARQL COALESCE or IF can mask them, and that the masking is limited to the November profile. It also covers the concat fixture grading, the OpenAPI version fields in the golden file, and the test results. It relates directly to the changeset.
